title: Note context edges are now agent-adjudicated, not blind cosine (RAG=recall, agent=precision)
summary: Reworked the orchestrator so a note context edge is a REASONED assertion, not a similarity score. The daemon stays dumb: it RECALLS candidates (semantic /search) and surfaces UNVERIFIED edges via GET /judge/next (persisted cursor + per-run budget, wraps, idles until epoch grows); an AGENT (skill self-learn-edge-judge) reasons keep/prune/create/surface via POST /judge/verdict. Default verdict is NO edge. Substrate: lib/judge.js (pure queue/cursor/budget/epoch); overlay gained epoch, judgedAtEpoch, judgeCursor. autowireNoteProvider + sweepOrphanNotes DEMOTED (stop writing similarity edges); note-create + rewire now bump epoch / re-enqueue instead. Boot migration tagged the ~273 blind note-provider edges (200 note->note + 73 note->task) judged:false,by:autowire; blocking/supersede/task-from edges untouched. surfaceSupersede is propose-only (guidance, never stamps validTo). Cursor/epoch/judgedAtEpoch persist across restart.
